scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace apps/server & npm run dev --workspace apps/web-next
scripts.web: npm run build --workspace apps/web-next && WEB_NEXT_ROOT=../web-next/dist npm run start --workspace apps/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web-next && npm run build --workspace v2/components && npm run build --workspace v2/playground
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/server && npm run test --workspace apps/web-next && npm run test --workspace v2/components && npm run test --workspace v2/playground
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web-next && tsc -p v2/components && tsc -p v2/playground
